name: Privacy
overview: Scripture teaches that nothing remains hidden forever, as all things covered will eventually be revealed, emphasizing God's sovereign knowledge over every detail of our lives (Luke 12:2). While our private thoughts and actions may seem concealed, the Lord’s revelation assures that truth will come to light. Believers are empowered through Christ to live transparently and courageously in this reality (Philippians 4:13), trusting in His strength as the ultimate revealer of all things, as shown in the prophetic unveiling given to John (Revelation 1:1).
